# Little Jem

## Overview

- **Age:** Thirteen years old at the end of Volume 5  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c4 P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v5 c1 P5](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0005), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c35 P9](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Four Winds Harbor, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v4 c19 P1](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0001), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Queen's Academy  <sub>[v5 c23 P0](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0000), [v5 c35 P9](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0009)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Jem  <sub>[v5 c2 P4](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0004)</sub>; Little Jem  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>; James Matthew  <sub>[v4 c34 P21](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Jem is a sturdy, reliable boy who grows to be an awful big thirteen-year-old. He has curly red hair like his mother's, frank hazel eyes and a steady, humorous mouth like his father's, and a fine nose. He is also noted for having nice, well-shaped ears.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c3 P9](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0009), [v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)_

## Personality

Jem is a brave, sturdy, and reliable boy who never breaks a promise. He is not a great talker, but enjoys investigating the truth of things for himself through practical experiments. He possesses a strong sense of comradeship, an adventurous spirit, and a deep love for nature and outdoor pursuits.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011), [v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 c35 P11](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0011)_

## Traits

- Reliable and honest  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>
- Inquisitive and observant  <sub>[v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011)</sub>
- Adventurous and brave  <sub>[v5 c35 P11](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0011)</sub>
- Dislikes being called 'Little Jem'  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>

## Abilities

- Expert fisher and woodsman  <sub>[v5 c3 P7](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0007), [v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011)</sub>
- Mimicking calls of wild birds and beasts  <sub>[v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011)</sub>
- Outdoor cooking  <sub>[v5 c3 P7](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0007)</sub>

## Goals

- To become a soldier or general and see the world  <sub>[v5 c7 P44](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0044), [v5 c35 P11](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0011)</sub>
- To succeed in his studies at Queen's Academy  <sub>[v5 c23 P0](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0000), [v5 c35 P9](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0009)</sub>

## History

James Matthew Blythe, commonly known as Jem, was born in the little house of dreams at Four Winds Harbor to Dr. Gilbert and Anne Blythe. As he grew up at Ingleside in Glen St. Mary, he developed a deep love for Rainbow Valley, where he spent countless hours exploring, fishing, and playing with his siblings and the Meredith children from the manse. Jem proved to be an adventurous and practical leader among his peers. After completing his early schooling, he passed his entrance examinations and left for Charlottetown to attend Queen's Academy.

_Sources: [v4 c34 P0](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0000), [v4 c34 P21](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0021), [v5 c1 P5](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0005), [v5 c3 P0](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0000), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046), [v5 c23 P0](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0000), [v5 c35 P9](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0009)_

## Background by volume

- Named James Matthew after Captain Jim Boyd and Matthew Cuthbert  <sub>[v4 c34 P21](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0021)</sub>
- Born in the little house of dreams at Four Winds Harbor  <sub>[v4 c34 P0](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0000), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>
- Inherited Captain Jim's museum of curiosities  <sub>[v4 c35 P40](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0040), [v5 c5 P28](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0028)</sub>

## Quotes

> I'm not little any more, Mother. I'm awful big.  <sub>[v5 c3 P9](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0009)</sub>
